ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW: Enumerate specific candidate dead-weight scripts in scope

Add done definition listing the specific scripts whose dead-weight status will be evaluated: review-integrity-guard.sh, compute-diff-hash.sh, emit-review-result.sh, record-review.sh, record-test-status.sh, review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh, skip-review-check.sh, plan-review-gate.sh, review-stop-check.sh, pre-bash-functions.sh review-related sections, and the .pre-commit-config.yaml ticket-gate entries. The story also evaluates 15+ test files in tests/ for orphan tests.
